seoTitle: Bar Chart Race Animator (Animated SVG, Pausable)
metaDescription: Turn a table of periods and items into a looping animated SVG where bars re-sort and grow over time. Pause control included. Free.
intro: Builds an animated bar chart race as a CSS-animated SVG from a table with one row per period and one column per item.
why:
Races show how rankings change over time. This version creates an animated SVG with CSS keyframes, which you can embed in a page and pause, rather than a video file. WebM or MP4 export is not offered.

The preview has a Pause animation switch, which starts on if you prefer reduced motion. Choose a single period to see a static frame with values. The table under the chart has all numbers, which is also the text equivalent.
howTo: Paste a table: first column period, other columns items.
Set how many bars to show and seconds per period.
Type a period name to see one still frame.
Download the SVG to keep the animation.

faq.a: Not here. Record the screen or use the SVG on a web page.
Yes, forever, and you can pause it.

faq.q: Why no value labels while moving?
faq.a: Numbers cannot be animated in CSS; the still frame and table show them.
